schemas.ErrorParameter: A name-value pair describing an input parameter that is associated with an error
schemas.BaseResponse: Base response of the createOrReplaceInventoryItem, createOrReplaceInventoryItemGroup and createOrReplaceProductCompatibility calls, returned only when errors or warnings occur.
schemas.BulkPriceQuantity: Request payload of bulkUpdatePriceQuantity, which updates the total ship-to-home quantity of up to 25 inventory items and/or the price and quantity of specific published offers.
schemas.BulkPriceQuantityResponse: Response of bulkUpdatePriceQuantity, with an HTTP status code, offer ID and SKU for each offer or inventory item updated, plus any errors or warnings.
schemas.Charity: Charitable organization associated with the listing and the percentage of sale proceeds it receives. The organization must be registered with the PayPal Giving Fund to receive proceeds.
schemas.ConditionEnum: Condition of the inventory item. Each value maps to an eBay condition ID, and valid conditions vary by category.
schemas.CurrencyCodeEnum: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency codes for the supported currencies.
schemas.DayOfWeekEnum: Days of the week, used by the weeklySchedule container to specify fulfillment center cut-off times.
schemas.Dimension: Dimensions of a shipping package and their unit of measure. Conditionally required when the seller offers calculated shipping rates.
schemas.EbayOfferDetailsWithId: Offer details passed to the updateOffer call. Every field currently set on the offer must be passed, even unchanged ones; updating a published offer also updates the live listing.
schemas.EnergyEfficiencyLabel: Energy efficiency information for certain durable goods. The energy efficiency rating and range must be specified through the inventory item's aspects field.
schemas.ExtendedProducerResponsibility: IDs of the producer or importer related to the new item, packaging, added documentation or an eco-participation fee.
schemas.Fee: Expected listing fees per eBay marketplace for one or more unpublished offers, including any promotional discounts applied to a fee.
schemas.FormatTypeEnum: Listing format of the offer. Creating an auction offer reserves one unit of the item's available quantity until the auction ends.
schemas.Hazmat: Hazardous material information for the listing. The statements field is required; pictograms, signalWord and component are optional.
schemas.InventoryItemListing: SKU and offer ID pair returned in the inventoryItems container of the bulkMigrateListing response. Up to five pairs may be returned per listing.
schemas.InventoryItemResponse: Result of creating or updating one inventory item record with bulkCreateOrReplaceInventoryItem, identified by its SKU.
schemas.InventoryItemWithSkuLocale: Inventory item record to create or update with bulkCreateOrReplaceInventoryItem. Up to 25 records can be sent in one call.
schemas.InventoryLocationFull: Details of an inventory location for createInventoryLocation, including name, physical address, operating hours, special hours and phone number.
schemas.LengthUnitOfMeasureEnum: Unit of measure for the dimensions of a shipping package.
schemas.ListingDetails: eBay listing ID, listing status and quantity sold for an offer. Returned only for published offers.
schemas.ListingDurationEnum: Listing duration periods. GTC applies to fixed-price listings and is their only supported duration; the DAYS_n values apply to auction listings.
schemas.ListingPolicies: Business policies (payment, return and fulfillment) and custom policies for the listing. Every published offer needs payment, return and fulfillment policies; also holds shipping cost overrides, eBay Plus and Best Offer settings.
schemas.ListingStatusEnum: Status of the eBay listing associated with an offer.
schemas.LocaleEnum: Locale that indicates the language used to express the inventory item details.
schemas.MinimumAdvertisedPriceHandlingEnum: Controls how and when the Minimum Advertised Price is shown for an offer. Available only on the US site.
schemas.OfferKeyWithId: Unpublished offer for which getListingFees retrieves expected listing fees. Up to 250 offerId values can be passed.
schemas.OfferResponse: Response of the createOffer and updateOffer calls with any errors or warnings. The offerId is returned only by a successful createOffer call.
schemas.OfferResponseWithListingId: Publish status of an offer. Returns the eBay listing ID on success, or errors and/or warnings explaining why publishing failed.
schemas.OfferSkuResponse: Status of each offer the seller attempted to create with bulkCreateOffer. A successful offer has statusCode 200 and a new offerId; otherwise errors and/or warnings are returned.
schemas.OfferStatusEnum: Current status of the offer, published or unpublished.
schemas.PackageTypeEnum: Type of shipping package used to ship an inventory item.
schemas.PackageWeightAndSize: Package type, weight and dimensions of the shipping package. Weight and dimensions are required for calculated shipping; weight alone is required for flat-rate shipping with a weight surcharge.
schemas.PriceQuantity: Updates the total ship-to-home quantity of inventory items and/or the price and quantity of specific offers associated with them.
schemas.PriceQuantityResponse: Result for each offer or inventory item updated with bulkUpdatePriceQuantity, including any errors or warnings at that level.
schemas.PricingSummary: Listing price and Minimum Advertised Price and Strikethrough Pricing settings. Price is required before an offer is published, but can be omitted when the offer is created.
schemas.Product: Product details such as title, description, aspects and image links. Can include an ePID or GTIN (EAN, ISBN or UPC) to match a product in the eBay Catalog.
schemas.ProductIdentifier: Identifies a motor vehicle compatible with the inventory item, by eBay Product ID or K-Type value. The gtin field is for future use only.
schemas.PublishByInventoryItemGroupRequest: Request payload of publishByInventoryItemGroup, giving the inventory item group to publish and the eBay marketplace to publish it on.
schemas.ResponsiblePersonTypeEnum: Type of EU Responsible Person associated with a listing.
schemas.ShippingCostOverride: Overrides the shipping cost for one item, each additional item, or the surcharge of a domestic or international shipping service option in the fulfillment policy applied to the offer.
schemas.ShippingServiceTypeEnum: Whether the shipping service option whose costs are overridden is domestic or international.
schemas.SoldOnEnum: Where the product was sold for the originalRetailPrice: on eBay, off eBay, or both. Applies only to listings eligible for Strikethrough Pricing.
schemas.Specification: Product aspect on which variations within an inventory item group vary, such as size or color, and the order its values appear in the listing.
schemas.StatusEnum: Possible states of an inventory location.
schemas.StoreTypeEnum: Inventory location types. STORE is deprecated and no longer supported.
schemas.Tax: Enables a sales-tax table, sets a tax exception category code, or specifies a VAT percentage. Sales-tax tables are available only for the US and Canada marketplaces.
schemas.TimeDurationUnitEnum: Time unit used by the TimeDuration type, typically BUSINESS_DAY for order fulfillment time.
schemas.Weight: Weight of a shipping package and its unit of measure. Conditionally required for calculated shipping rates or flat-rate shipping with a weight surcharge.
schemas.WeightUnitOfMeasureEnum: Unit of measure for the weight of a shipping package.

requestBodies.createOrReplaceSkuLocationMapping: Fulfillment locations to map to the listing and SKU combination

bulkCreateOrReplaceInventoryItem.summary: Bulk create or replace inventory items
bulkCreateOrReplaceInventoryItem.description: Creates or replaces up to 25 inventory item records in one call. Updating an existing record is a complete replacement, and changes to items in active listings automatically update those listings. Requires the Content-Language and Content-Type headers.

bulkGetInventoryItem.description: Retrieves up to 25 inventory item records by the SKU values given in the request payload. Requires the Content-Type header.

bulkUpdatePriceQuantity.description: Updates the ship-to-home quantity of one inventory item and/or the price and quantity of up to 25 of its offers. Only one SKU can be updated per call, and published offers are revised on their live listings. Requires the Content-Type header.

getInventoryItem.description: Retrieves the inventory item record for the given SKU.

createOrReplaceInventoryItem.summary: Create or replace an inventory item
createOrReplaceInventoryItem.description: Creates a new inventory item record or replaces an existing one for the given SKU. Replacing is a complete replacement, and changes to an item in active listings automatically update those listings. Requires the Content-Type and Content-Language headers.

deleteInventoryItem.description: Deletes the inventory item record for the given SKU. It also deletes the SKU's unpublished offers and single-variation listings, and removes the SKU from multiple-variation listings and inventory item groups.

getInventoryItems.description: Retrieves all inventory item records defined for the seller's account. Use the limit and offset query parameters to page through the results.

getProductCompatibility.description: Retrieves the list of products compatible with the inventory item identified by the given SKU. Product compatibility currently applies only to motor vehicle parts and accessory categories.

createOrReplaceProductCompatibility.description: Creates or replaces the list of products compatible with the inventory item identified by the given SKU. Product compatibility currently applies only to motor vehicle parts and accessory categories. Requires the Content-Type and Content-Language headers.

deleteProductCompatibility.description: Deletes the list of products compatible with the inventory item identified by the given SKU. Product compatibility currently applies only to motor vehicle parts and accessory categories.

createOrReplaceInventoryItemGroup.summary: Create or replace an inventory item group
createOrReplaceInventoryItemGroup.description: Creates or replaces an inventory item group identified by the given key. Replacing is a complete replacement including member SKUs, and changes automatically update any live multiple-variation listing. Requires the Content-Type and Content-Language headers.

bulkMigrateListing.description: Migrates one to five existing fixed-price eBay listings to Inventory API objects, creating inventory item, offer, location and, where applicable, item group and product compatibility objects. Listings must have SKUs and use business policies. Requires the Content-Type header.

getSkuLocationMapping.description: Retrieves the fulfillment center locations mapped to a single SKU within a listing. Returns 404 Not Found if no locations are mapped to the SKU.

createOrReplaceSkuLocationMapping.summary: Create or replace a SKU location mapping
createOrReplaceSkuLocationMapping.description: Maps fulfillment center locations to a single SKU within a listing to improve estimated delivery dates. Replacing is a complete replacement of the SKU's mappings, and only locations of type FULFILLMENT_CENTER are supported.

deleteSkuLocationMapping.description: Removes all location mappings for a single SKU within a listing. For a multiple-variation listing, call it for each SKU.

bulkCreateOffer.description: Creates up to 25 offers for specific inventory items on an eBay marketplace. The sku, marketplaceId and format fields are always required, and offers are only staged until published. Requires the Content-Type and Content-Language headers.

bulkPublishOffer.description: Publishes up to 25 unpublished offers as live eBay listings. Some offers may succeed while others fail, and the response reports the result for each offer.

getOffers.description: Retrieves all existing offers for the given SKU, optionally filtered by marketplace or listing format. A SKU offered as both an auction and a fixed-price listing returns two offers.

createOffer.description: Creates an offer for a specific inventory item on an eBay marketplace. The sku, marketplaceId and format fields are required, and the offer is only staged until it is published. Requires the Content-Type and Content-Language headers.

getOffer.description: Retrieves a specific published or unpublished offer by its offer ID.

updateOffer.description: Updates an existing published or unpublished offer. This is a complete replacement, so all current fields are required, and listingDescription is required for published offers. Requires the Content-Type and Content-Language headers.

deleteOffer.description: Permanently deletes an unpublished offer, or ends or removes the variation of a published offer's live listing. A variation with one or more sales is not removed from a multiple-variation listing.

getListingFees.description: Retrieves the expected listing fees for up to 250 unpublished offers, grouped by eBay marketplace. Passing published offers results in errors.

publishOffer.description: Publishes an unpublished offer as a live eBay listing. The offer is identified by its offer ID.

publishOfferByInventoryItemGroup.summary: Publish offers by inventory item group
publishOfferByInventoryItemGroup.description: Publishes all unpublished offers of an inventory item group as an active multiple-variation listing. Items missing required data or offers are left out, and the call fails if any item has invalid or conflicting data.

withdrawOffer.description: Ends the single-variation listing associated with the given offer without deleting the offer. The offer returns to the unpublished state and must be published again to relist.

withdrawOfferByInventoryItemGroup.summary: Withdraw offers by inventory item group
withdrawOfferByInventoryItemGroup.description: Ends the multiple-variation listing associated with the given inventory item group. The group and its offers are not deleted, and all of the offers return to the unpublished state.

createInventoryLocation.description: Creates a new inventory location identified by a seller-defined merchant location key. Every offer must be associated with a location, and the key and physical location cannot be changed once set. Locations are enabled by default.

deleteInventoryLocation.description: Deletes the given inventory location without affecting active listings, but its offers can no longer be modified. Deletion is not supported for fulfillment center locations, which should be disabled instead.

disableInventoryLocation.description: Disables the given inventory location so inventory can no longer be loaded or modified there. Active listings are not affected, but offers associated with the location can no longer be modified.

enableInventoryLocation.description: Enables a disabled inventory location so sellers can load and modify inventory there again.

getInventoryLocations.description: Retrieves all inventory locations defined for the seller's account. Use the limit and offset query parameters to page through the results.

updateInventoryLocation.description: Updates the details of an existing inventory location, replacing the current values of the fields passed in. Address fields can be updated for warehouse locations but not for fulfillment center locations.

properties.Address.addressLine1: The first line of the street address. Required for fulfillment center locations, optional for warehouse locations. Returned if defined. Maximum length: 128.
properties.Address.addressLine2: The second line of the street address, such as a suite or apartment number. Returned if defined. Maximum length: 128.
properties.Address.city: The city of the inventory location. Required for fulfillment centers; for warehouses, required with stateOrProvince if postalCode is not provided. Returned if defined. Maximum length: 128.
properties.Address.postalCode: The postal or zip code of the address. Required for fulfillment centers; for warehouses, required if a city and stateOrProvince pair is not provided. Returned if defined. Maximum length: 16.
properties.Address.stateOrProvince: The state or province of the inventory location. Required for fulfillment centers; for warehouses, required with city if postalCode is not provided. Maximum length: 128.
properties.Amount.currency: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code. Both value and currency are required and always returned when expressing prices.
properties.AvailabilityDistribution.merchantLocatio: The unique identifier of the inventory location that holds quantity of the inventory item. Conditionally required to identify that location.
properties.BaseResponse.warnings: The errors or warnings triggered by the call, returned only if any occur.
properties.BestOffer.bestOfferEnabled: Whether the Best Offer feature is enabled for the listing; set to true to enable it. Not available for multi-variation listings.
properties.BulkInventoryItem.requests: The inventory items to create or update. Up to 25 inventory items per call.
properties.BulkPriceQuantity.requests: The inventory items (up to 25) whose ship-to-home quantity to update, and/or the published offers whose price or quantity to update.
properties.BulkPriceQuantityResponse.responses: The result for each offer or inventory item updated, with the HTTP status code, offer ID, SKU and any errors or warnings.
properties.Charity.charityId: The eBay-assigned unique identifier of the charitable organization that receives a percentage of sales proceeds. Required when donating to a charity.
properties.Charity.donationPercentage: The percentage of the purchase price donated to the charity, from 10 to 100 in increments of 5. Required when donating to a charity.
properties.Compatibility.sku: The seller-defined SKU of the inventory item associated with the compatible vehicles. Always returned by getProductCompatibility.
properties.CompatibleProduct.compatibilityPropertie: The vehicle aspect name-value pairs (such as make, model, year, trim and engine) that identify a compatible motor vehicle. Make, model and year are typically required.
properties.CompatibleProduct.notes: Seller notes about the compatible vehicle, such as the part's placement on the vehicle. Returned only if set. Maximum length: 500.
properties.ConditionDescriptor.additionalInfo: Open-text additional information for a condition descriptor, such as a certification number or damage code for graded items. Maximum length: 30.
properties.ConditionDescriptor.name: The numeric ID of the condition descriptor name. Condition descriptor name-value pairs describe an item's condition in a structured way.
properties.ConditionDescriptor.values: The numeric IDs of the values for the condition descriptor, such as a grader, grade or card condition.
properties.CountryPolicy.policyIds: The custom policy identifiers, such as product compliance or take-back policies, that apply to the specified country.
properties.Dimension.height: The height of the shipping package, in the unit given in the unit field. All dimension fields are required if package dimensions are specified.
properties.Dimension.length: The length of the shipping package, in the unit given in the unit field. All dimension fields are required if package dimensions are specified.
properties.Dimension.width: The width of the shipping package, in the unit given in the unit field. All dimension fields are required if package dimensions are specified.
properties.EbayOfferDetailsWithAll.availableQuantit: The quantity of the inventory item available for purchase on the marketplace given in marketplaceId.
properties.EbayOfferDetailsWithAll.hideBuyerDetails: Whether the private listing feature is enabled, hiding buyer IDs from other users. Always returned; defaults to false.
properties.EbayOfferDetailsWithAll.includeCatalogPr: Whether eBay product catalog details are applied to the listing, based on the product identifier. Defaults to true.
properties.EbayOfferDetailsWithAll.listingDescripti: The listing description of the offer. Always returned for published offers, and only if set for unpublished offers. Maximum length: 500,000, including HTML markup.
properties.EbayOfferDetailsWithAll.listingStartDate: The UTC date and time the seller set for a scheduled listing to become active, for example 2023-05-30T19:08:00Z. Returned if set.
properties.EbayOfferDetailsWithAll.lotSize: The number of identical items sold in a lot listing. Returned only for lot listings.
properties.EbayOfferDetailsWithAll.merchantLocation: The unique identifier of the inventory location; it cannot be modified once set. Always returned for published offers, and only if set for unpublished offers. Maximum length: 36.
properties.EbayOfferDetailsWithAll.quantityLimitPer: The maximum quantity of the inventory item that each buyer may purchase, across one or more transactions. Set only if the seller restricts purchase quantity.
properties.EbayOfferDetailsWithAll.secondaryCategor: The unique identifier of a secondary category, used when listing the item in two categories. A fee may apply.
properties.EbayOfferDetailsWithAll.storeCategoryNam: The full paths of up to two eBay store categories the item is placed in, such as /Fashion/Men/Shirts. Returned if set.
properties.EbayOfferDetailsWithId.availableQuantity: The quantity of the inventory item available through the offer; must be 1 or more to be purchasable. Omit for auction listings, and resend in updateOffer if already set.
properties.EbayOfferDetailsWithId.categoryId: The unique identifier of the eBay category the item is listed under. Required before the offer is published, and must be resent in updateOffer if already set.
properties.EbayOfferDetailsWithId.hideBuyerDetails: Set to true to enable, or false to remove, the private listing feature, which hides buyer IDs from other users.
properties.EbayOfferDetailsWithId.includeCatalogPro: Whether eBay product catalog details are applied to the listing, based on the product identifier. Defaults to true.
properties.EbayOfferDetailsWithId.listingDescriptio: The listing description; HTML is allowed. Required before the offer is published, and must be resent in updateOffer if already set. Maximum length: 500,000, including HTML markup.
properties.EbayOfferDetailsWithId.listingStartDate: The future UTC date and time an unpublished offer's listing becomes active, for example 2023-05-30T19:08:00Z. Optional; if omitted, the listing starts once published.
properties.EbayOfferDetailsWithId.lotSize: The total number of items in a lot listing, whether identical or a mixed lot. Applies only to lot listings.
properties.EbayOfferDetailsWithId.merchantLocationK: The unique identifier of the inventory location where the item is located. Required before the offer is published. Maximum length: 36.
properties.EbayOfferDetailsWithId.quantityLimitPerB: The maximum quantity that each buyer may purchase, across one or more transactions. Must be resent in updateOffer if already set.
properties.EbayOfferDetailsWithId.secondaryCategory: The unique identifier of a secondary category, used when listing the item in two categories. A fee may apply.
properties.EbayOfferDetailsWithId.storeCategoryName: The full paths of up to two eBay store categories to place the item in, such as /Fashion/Men/Shirts. Must be resent in updateOffer if already set.
properties.EbayOfferDetailsWithKeys.availableQuanti: The quantity of the inventory item available for purchase on the marketplace; must be 1 or more to be purchasable. Overrides the inventory item quantity. Omit for auction listings.
properties.EbayOfferDetailsWithKeys.categoryId: The unique identifier of the eBay category the product is listed under. Not required when creating the offer, but required before it is published.
properties.EbayOfferDetailsWithKeys.hideBuyerDetail: Set to true to create a private listing, which hides buyer IDs from other users.
properties.EbayOfferDetailsWithKeys.includeCatalogP: Whether eBay product catalog details are applied to the listing, based on the product identifier. Defaults to true.
properties.EbayOfferDetailsWithKeys.listingDescript: The listing description; HTML is allowed. Required before the offer is published. Maximum length: 500,000, including HTML markup.
properties.EbayOfferDetailsWithKeys.listingStartDat: The future UTC date and time the listing becomes active, for example 2023-05-30T19:08:00Z. Optional; if omitted, the listing starts once published.
properties.EbayOfferDetailsWithKeys.lotSize: The total number of items in a lot listing, whether identical or a mixed lot. Applies only to lot listings.
properties.EbayOfferDetailsWithKeys.merchantLocatio: The unique identifier of the inventory location where the item is located. Not required when creating the offer, but required before it is published. Maximum length: 36.
properties.EbayOfferDetailsWithKeys.quantityLimitPe: The maximum quantity that each buyer may purchase, across one or more transactions. Set only if the seller restricts purchase quantity.
properties.EbayOfferDetailsWithKeys.secondaryCatego: The unique identifier of a secondary category, used when listing the item in two categories. A fee may apply.
properties.EbayOfferDetailsWithKeys.sku: The seller-defined SKU of the product to list. Required. Only one offer may exist per SKU, marketplace and format combination. Maximum length: 50.
properties.EbayOfferDetailsWithKeys.storeCategoryNa: The full paths of up to two eBay store categories to place the item in, such as /Fashion/Men/Shirts.
properties.Fee.feeType: The type of listing fee the seller may incur if the offers are published, such as InsertionFee or SubtitleFee. Fees may be returned even when 0.0.
properties.FeeSummary.fees: The listing fees expected to apply to an offer on the marketplace. Fees may be returned even when 0.0.
properties.FeesSummaryResponse.feeSummaries: The listing fees the seller can expect to pay for the specified unpublished offers. Fees may be returned even when 0.0.
properties.GeoCoordinates.latitude: The latitude (north-south) of the location, for example 33.089805. Required if geoCoordinates is used; returned if set.
properties.GeoCoordinates.longitude: The longitude (east-west) of the location, for example -88.709822. Required if geoCoordinates is used; returned if set.
properties.GetInventoryItemResponse.statusCode: The HTTP status code indicating whether the inventory item for the given SKU was retrieved successfully.
properties.Hazmat.pictograms: The hazard pictogram codes stated on the product's Safety Data Sheet, displayed on the listing.
properties.Hazmat.signalWord: The hazardous materials signal word stated on the product's Safety Data Sheet, displayed on the listing.
properties.Hazmat.statements: The hazard statement codes stated on the product's Safety Data Sheet. Required if hazardous material information is provided.
properties.InventoryItem.conditionDescription: A description of a used item's condition; ignored for new conditions. Required when updating an item that already has one. Returned if set. Maximum length: 1000.
properties.InventoryItem.conditionDescriptors: Structured name-value pairs that describe the item's condition, required for graded or ungraded trading cards and coins.
properties.InventoryItemGroup.aspects: The item specifics name-value pairs shared by all variations in the group, such as pattern. Required before the group's first offer is published.
properties.InventoryItemGroup.description: The group's description, which becomes the listing description; HTML is allowed. Required before the first offer is published. Maximum length: 500,000, including HTML markup.
properties.InventoryItemGroup.imageUrls: HTTPS links to images for the group. At least one image is required before publishing, and images must be given here if aspectsImageVariesBy is used.
properties.InventoryItemGroup.inventoryItemGroupKey: The seller-created unique identifier of the inventory item group. Returned by getInventoryItemGroup.
properties.InventoryItemGroup.subtitle: An optional listing subtitle for the group, which incurs an extra fee and overrides item subtitles. Returned if set. Maximum length: 55.
properties.InventoryItemGroup.title: The group's title, which becomes the listing title. Required before the first offer of the group is published. Maximum length: 80.
properties.InventoryItemGroup.variantSKUs: The SKUs of the inventory items in the group. Required and always returned; omit a SKU to remove it, unless that variation has sales.
properties.InventoryItemGroup.videoIds: The eBay video IDs for the group, created when a video is uploaded. Only one video per listing is supported.
properties.InventoryItemListing.offerId: The eBay-generated unique identifier of the offer created by the listing migration. Returned only if the migration succeeds.
properties.InventoryItemListing.sku: The seller-defined SKU of the item in the listing, used to manage the inventory item after migration. Returned even if the migration fails.
properties.InventoryItemResponse.statusCode: The HTTP status code indicating whether the inventory item for the given SKU was created or updated successfully.
properties.InventoryItemWithSkuLocale.conditionDesc: A description of a used item's condition; ignored for new conditions. Required when updating an item that already has one. Returned if set. Maximum length: 1000.
Structured name-value pairs that describe the item's condition, required for graded or ungraded trading cards and coins.
properties.InventoryItemWithSkuLocale.sku: The seller-defined SKU of the product to list. Required. Only one offer may exist per SKU, marketplace and format combination. Maximum length: 50.
properties.InventoryItemWithSkuLocaleGroupKeys.cond: A description of a used item's condition; ignored for items in a new condition. Maximum length: 1000.
Structured name-value pairs that describe the item's condition, required for graded or ungraded trading cards and coins.
properties.InventoryItemWithSkuLocaleGroupKeys.inve: The identifiers of the inventory item groups the item belongs to. Returned only if the item is in a group.
properties.InventoryItemWithSkuLocaleGroupid.condit: A description of a used item's condition; ignored for items in a new condition. Maximum length: 1000.
Structured name-value pairs that describe the item's condition, required for graded or ungraded trading cards and coins.
properties.InventoryItemWithSkuLocaleGroupid.groupI: The unique identifiers of the inventory item groups the item belongs to. Returned only if the item is in at least one group.
properties.InventoryItemWithSkuLocaleGroupid.invent: The unique identifiers of the item's variations in multiple-variation listings. Returned only if the item is in at least one inventory item group.
properties.InventoryItems.total: The total number of inventory items in the seller's account, used with the limit value to page through results.
properties.InventoryLocation.locationAdditionalInfo: Additional information about the inventory location; replaces the current value, so resend it unchanged if not updating. Maximum length: 256.
properties.InventoryLocation.locationWebUrl: The website URL of the inventory location; replaces any existing URL. Maximum length: 512.
properties.InventoryLocation.name: A human-friendly name for the inventory location; replaces any existing name. Not required for warehouse locations.
properties.InventoryLocation.phone: The phone number of the inventory location; replaces any existing phone number. Maximum length: 36.
properties.InventoryLocation.timeZoneId: The time zone of the inventory location in Olson format (for example America/Vancouver). Used for all hour-related fields; if omitted, it is derived from the address.
properties.InventoryLocationFull.timeZoneId: The time zone of the inventory location in Olson format (for example America/Vancouver). Used for all hour-related fields; if omitted for a fulfillment center, it is derived from the address.
properties.InventoryLocationResponse.timeZoneId: The time zone of the inventory location in Olson format (for example America/Vancouver).
properties.ListingDetails.listingOnHold: Whether the listing is on hold due to a policy violation. Returned as true while the listing is fixable and no longer returned once it is fixed.
properties.ListingPolicies.eBayPlusIfEligible: Set to true if a Top-Rated seller is opted in to the eBay Plus program (next-day delivery and free returns). Returned if set for the offer.
properties.ListingPolicies.fulfillmentPolicyId: The ID of the fulfillment business policy that sets the fulfillment settings for the listing. Required before the offer can be published; returned if set.
properties.ListingPolicies.paymentPolicyId: The ID of the payment business policy that sets the payment settings for the listing. Required before the offer can be published; returned if set.
properties.ListingPolicies.productCompliancePolicyI: The IDs of the seller's global product compliance policies to apply to the listing. Maximum of six per offer.
properties.ListingPolicies.returnPolicyId: The ID of the return business policy that sets the return settings for the listing. Required before the offer can be published; returned if set.
properties.ListingPolicies.shippingCostOverrides: Overrides the shipping costs or surcharge of shipping service options in the fulfillment policy, one entry per option. Returned if any overrides are applied.
properties.ListingPolicies.takeBackPolicyId: The ID of the seller's global take-back policy to apply to the listing. Only one per offer.
properties.Location.locationId: The eBay-assigned ID of the location, used only internally by eBay. Not the same as the seller-defined merchantLocationKey.
properties.LocationAvailabilityDetails.merchantLoca: The seller-defined key of the fulfillment center location where inventory is available. For location mappings, it must be a FULFILLMENT_CENTER location.
properties.LocationMapping.locations: The fulfillment center locations mapped to the SKU. Only the first 50 locations are used to calculate estimated delivery dates.
properties.LocationResponse.offset: The number of results skipped before the first returned result, as set by the offset query parameter. The list is zero-based.
properties.Manufacturer.addressLine2: The second line of the manufacturer's street address, such as a suite or apartment number. Maximum length: 180 characters.
properties.MigrateListing.listingId: The unique identifier of the eBay listing to migrate to the Inventory model. Up to five listings can be specified.
properties.MigrateListingResponse.inventoryItemGrou: The eBay-generated key of the inventory item group created for a migrated multiple-variation listing. Returned only for multiple-variation listings.
properties.MigrateListingResponse.inventoryItems: The SKU values and offer IDs of the migrated listing: one pair for a single-variation listing, several for a multiple-variation listing.
properties.MigrateListingResponse.warnings: Details of any warnings raised while migrating the listing. A listing can still migrate successfully with warnings.
properties.NameValueList.name: The motor vehicle aspect name, such as make, model, year, trim or engine. Make, model and year are typically required.
properties.NameValueList.value: The value of the motor vehicle aspect named in the name field, for example Toyota for make.
properties.OfferKeyWithId.offerId: The ID of an unpublished offer to retrieve expected listing fees for. Up to 250 per request; published offers cause errors.
properties.OfferKeysWithId.offers: The unpublished offers (up to 250) to retrieve expected listing fees for. Fees are returned per marketplace, not per offer.
properties.OfferPriceQuantity.availableQuantity: The quantity of the item available in the offer's marketplace; should not exceed the total ship-to-home quantity. Either this or price is required.
properties.OfferPriceQuantity.offerId: The unique identifier of the offer to update with a new price and/or quantity. Required when updating offers.
properties.OfferResponse.offerId: The unique identifier of the offer created by createOffer. Returned only on success and not returned by updateOffer.
properties.OfferResponseWithListingId.statusCode: The HTTP status code indicating whether publishing the offer succeeded or failed.
properties.OfferSkuResponse.offerId: The unique identifier of the newly created offer. Not returned if the offer could not be created.
properties.OfferSkuResponse.sku: The seller-defined SKU of the inventory item. Required for each offer and always returned.
properties.OfferSkuResponse.statusCode: The HTTP status code of the offer creation attempt; 200 indicates success.
properties.OfferSkuResponse.warnings: Warnings raised while creating the offer. An offer can still be created successfully with warnings.
properties.Offers.offers: The seller's offers for the SKU passed in the sku query parameter. Maximum of 25.
properties.Offers.size: The number of offers on the current page of results.
properties.Offers.total: The total number of offers for the SKU, used with the limit value to page through results.
properties.Overrides.cutOffTime: The cut-off time that overrides the weekly schedule for the date range; orders after it are handled the next day. Format: 00:00.
properties.Overrides.endDate: The end date of the cut-off time override in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD). Use the same date as startDate for a single day.
properties.Overrides.startDate: The start date of the cut-off time override in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD). Use the same date as endDate for a single day.
properties.PackageWeightAndSize.shippingIrregular: Whether the package is irregular and needs special or fragile handling. Applies to calculated shipping only.
properties.PriceQuantity.offers: The published offers whose price and/or quantity to update, one entry per offer. Not for unpublished offers.
properties.PriceQuantity.sku: The seller-defined SKU of the inventory item whose total ship-to-home quantity is updated. Required only when using shipToLocationAvailability. Maximum length: 50.
properties.PriceQuantityResponse.sku: The seller-defined SKU of the product. Always returned. Maximum length: 50.
properties.PriceQuantityResponse.statusCode: The HTTP status code of the price and/or quantity update attempt; 200 indicates success.
properties.Product.aspects: Item specifics (product aspects) as name-value pairs describing the product. Required before an offer can be published. Maximum lengths: name 40, value 50.
properties.Product.brand: The brand of the product, often paired with mpn. Conditionally required if the category requires an MPN. Returned if defined. Maximum length: 65.
properties.Product.description: The description of the product; supports basic HTML but no active content. Required before an offer can be published. Returned if defined. Maximum length: 4000.
properties.Product.ean: The European Article Number (EAN) of the product, used to find a match in the eBay Catalog. Returned if defined.
properties.Product.epid: The eBay Product Identifier (ePID), the preferred way to match a product in the eBay Catalog and auto-populate product details. Returned if defined.
properties.Product.imageUrls: HTTPS URLs of the product images. At least one is required before an offer can be published; up to 24 per listing, or 12 per item in a group.
properties.Product.isbn: The International Standard Book Number (ISBN) of the product, used to find a match in the eBay Catalog. Returned if defined.
properties.Product.mpn: The Manufacturer Part Number (MPN) of the product, paired with brand. Required by some categories. Returned if defined. Maximum length: 65.
properties.Product.subtitle: An optional subtitle with extra product information; an additional listing fee applies. Returned only if set. Maximum length: 55.
properties.Product.title: The title of the inventory item. Required before an offer can be published; for a group, it becomes the variation title. Maximum length: 80.
properties.Product.upc: The Universal Product Code (UPC) of the product, used to find a match in the eBay Catalog. Returned if defined.
properties.Product.videoIds: The eBay-generated IDs of videos uploaded for the product. Only one video per listing is supported.
properties.ProductIdentifier.epid: The eBay catalog product ID (ePID) of the compatible motor vehicle; if found, its properties are filled in automatically.
properties.ProductIdentifier.gtin: The Global Trade Item Number of the compatible motor vehicle. Reserved for future use.
properties.ProductIdentifier.ktype: The K Type Number of the compatible motor vehicle; if found, its properties are filled in automatically. Supported only on the AU, DE, ES, FR, IT and UK marketplaces.
properties.ProductSafety.component: Product safety component information, such as a specific warning. Requires pictograms and/or statements. Maximum length: 120 characters.
properties.ProductSafety.pictograms: The identifiers of product safety pictograms to display on the listing. Maximum of 2.
properties.ProductSafety.statements: The identifiers of product safety statements to display on the listing. Maximum of 8.
properties.PublishByInventoryItemGroupRequest.inven: The eBay-generated key of the inventory item group whose unpublished offers are published as a multiple-variation listing.
properties.PublishResponse.listingId: The unique identifier of the newly created eBay listing. Returned if the offer or group of offers was successfully published.
properties.Regulatory.documents: Regulatory documents associated with the listing. Conditionally required for sellers in or shipping to the EU or Northern Ireland.
properties.Regulatory.repairScore: The manufacturer's repair score, from 0.0 (difficult to repair) to 10.0 (easily repaired), with at most one decimal place. Not applicable to all categories.
properties.Regulatory.responsiblePersons: The EU-based Responsible Persons or entities for the listing. Maximum of 5; conditionally required for sellers in or shipping to the EU or Northern Ireland.
properties.ResponsiblePerson.addressLine2: The second line of the Responsible Person's address, such as a suite or apartment number. Maximum length: 180 characters.
properties.SameDayShippingCutOffTimes.weeklySchedul: The weekly schedule of shipping cut-off times, required for each business day; orders after the cut-off are handled the next day.
properties.ShipToLocationAvailability.availabilityD: The available quantity of the inventory item at one or more warehouse locations. Returned if set.
properties.ShipToLocationAvailability.quantity: The total ship-to-home quantity available across all marketplaces. Must be set before an offer can be published; resend it on updates or it is lost.
properties.ShipToLocationAvailabilityWithAll.availa: The available quantity of the inventory item at one or more warehouse locations. Returned if set.
properties.ShipToLocationAvailabilityWithAll.quanti: The total ship-to-home quantity available for purchase. Must be set before publishing; omitting it or 0 makes the listing out of stock. Resend it on updates or it is lost.
properties.ShippingCostOverride.priority: The sort order of the shipping service option in the fulfillment policy whose costs are overridden. Required for each override and always returned.
properties.Specification.name: The name of the product variation aspect, such as Size or Color. Required before an offer can be published. Maximum length: 40.
properties.Specification.values: The values of the product variation aspect named in the name field. At least one value is required. Maximum length: 50.
properties.Tax.applyTax: Whether the seller's account-level sales-tax table is used to calculate sales tax. Must be true when thirdPartyTaxCategory is used. Returned if set.
properties.Tax.thirdPartyTaxCategory: The tax exception category code, which applies sales tax to a service or fee as well as the item price. Requires applyTax set to true. Returned if set.
properties.Tax.vatPercentage: The VAT rate for the item, up to 6 characters with 3 decimal places (for example 12.345). Only for business sellers with a registered VAT-ID. Returned if set.
properties.TimeDuration.value: The fulfillment time, in the unit given by the unit field.
properties.VariesBy.aspectsImageVariesBy: The product aspect, such as Color, whose variations are shown with different images. Only the first aspect is used. Required before an offer can be published.
properties.VariesBy.specifications: The product aspects that vary across the group and their values. Required before the first offer of the group is published; returned if set or once published.
properties.WeeklySchedule.cutOffTime: The cut-off time in 24-hour format for the specified days; defaults to the address time zone if timeZoneId is not set. Days without one are holidays. Format: 00:00.
properties.Weight.value: The weight of the shipping package in the unit given by the unit field. Both unit and value are required.
properties.WithdrawByInventoryItemGroupRequest.inve: The eBay-generated unique identifier of the inventory item group.

parameters.getInventoryItem.path.sku: Seller-defined SKU of the inventory item record to retrieve. Maximum length: 50.
parameters.getInventoryItems.query.limit: Maximum number of records to return per page, as an integer from 1 to 200. Default: 25.
parameters.getInventoryItems.query.offset: Page number to retrieve, starting at 0 for the first page. Default: 0.
parameters.getProductCompatibility.path.sku: SKU of the inventory item whose product compatibility list is retrieved.
parameters.deleteProductCompatibility.path.sku: SKU of the inventory item whose product compatibility list is deleted.
parameters.createOrReplaceInventoryItemGroup.path.i: Seller-defined unique identifier of the inventory item group to create or update. Cannot be changed once set. Maximum length: 50.
parameters.getSkuLocationMapping.path.listingId: Unique identifier of the listing that contains the SKU whose mapped locations are retrieved.
parameters.getSkuLocationMapping.path.sku: Seller-defined SKU of the item or variation whose location mappings are retrieved. Must be defined in the listing given by listingId.
parameters.createOrReplaceSkuLocationMapping.path.l: Unique identifier of the listing in which fulfillment center locations are mapped to a SKU.
parameters.createOrReplaceSkuLocationMapping.path.s: Seller-defined SKU of the item or variation to map fulfillment center locations to. Must be defined in the listing given by listingId.
parameters.deleteSkuLocationMapping.path.listingId: Unique identifier of the listing that contains the SKU whose mapped locations are removed.
parameters.deleteSkuLocationMapping.path.sku: Seller-defined SKU of the item or variation whose location mappings are removed. Must be defined in the listing given by listingId.
parameters.getOffers.query.format: Listing format of the offers to retrieve, such as FIXED_PRICE.
parameters.getOffers.query.limit: Maximum number of records to return per page, as a positive integer. Up to 100 records are returned if not set.
parameters.getOffers.query.marketplace_id: eBay marketplace ID to restrict the returned offers to one marketplace.
parameters.getOffers.query.offset: Page number to retrieve, as an integer of 0 or greater, starting at 0 for the first page. Default: 0.
parameters.getOffers.query.sku: Seller-defined SKU whose offers are returned. Maximum length: 50.
parameters.getInventoryLocation.path.merchantLocati: Unique merchant-defined key (ID) of the inventory location to retrieve. Maximum length: 36.
parameters.createInventoryLocation.path.merchantLoc: Unique merchant-defined key (ID) of the inventory location. Maximum length: 36.
parameters.deleteInventoryLocation.path.merchantLoc: Unique merchant-defined key (ID) of the inventory location to delete. Maximum length: 36.
parameters.disableInventoryLocation.path.merchantLo: Unique merchant-defined key (ID) of the inventory location to disable. Maximum length: 36.
parameters.enableInventoryLocation.path.merchantLoc: Unique merchant-defined key (ID) of the disabled inventory location to enable. Maximum length: 36.
parameters.getInventoryLocations.query.limit: Maximum number of records to return per page, as a positive integer (minimum 1). Up to 100 records are returned if not set.
parameters.getInventoryLocations.query.offset: Number of locations to skip before returning the first location in the paginated response. Default: 0.
parameters.updateInventoryLocation.path.merchantLoc: Unique merchant-defined key (ID) of the inventory location to update. Maximum length: 36.
